name: E-7 Foreign National of Special Ability (Designated Activities)

requirements.blocker_text: The role must match exactly one of 87 Ministry of Justice-designated E-7 occupation codes, and the applicant's academic major and career experience must align with that specific code -- a mismatched degree or job title is the single most common reason for refusal.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm the specific job title and duties map to a designated E-7-1 occupation code before an employer files.

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum annual salary of KRW 31,120,000, effective 1 February through 31 December 2026 under Ministry of Justice Public Notice No. 2025-406 -- this is a flat floor set directly by ministerial notice, not a percentage of GNI, and applies uniformly regardless of employer size since an April 2025 reform removed the older company-size-tiered scale.
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a base contractual salary at or above the current floor; bonuses and allowances are not reliably counted toward it.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a job offer from a Korean-registered employer who files the E-7 application; this is an employer-sponsored, employer-tied status.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Korean employer willing to sponsor the E-7 application.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract meeting the current salary floor for the applicable E-7 subclass
Degree certificate and career-history documentation matching the designated occupation code
Employer's business registration and, for some roles, an SME/venture/regional confirmation for reduced-floor eligibility

outcome.duration_length: 1-3 years, renewed with the employer sponsorship

sources.title: Ministry of Justice Public Notice No. 2025-406 (law/moj.go.kr 공고 제2025-406호), setting 2026 E-7 salary floors -- published via HiKorea and cross-corroborated across multiple independent immigration-services sources citing the same notice number and figures
HiKorea -- Korea Immigration Service's official portal for visa categories, ARC, and stay procedures

notes: STRUCTURAL FINDING, the largest single procedural overhaul found in the Korea build: since April 2025, E-7 salary floors are set as flat KRW figures by direct Ministry of Justice public notice (No. 2025-406 for 2026, published 29 Dec 2025, effective 1 Feb-31 Dec 2026) rather than calculated as a percentage of the prior year's per-capita GNI -- the older GNI-tiered scale, which varied by employer size (large firms vs SMEs/venture firms/non-metropolitan mid-sized companies), was removed. Multiple secondary sources still describe the salary floor as '80% of GNI' or similar percentage formulas, which is the exact live-staleness pattern flagged repeatedly across this dataset (Poland's Type A/B/C renaming, Saudi Arabia's SSCO reform) -- the correct 2026 figure is the flat KRW 31,120,000 published directly by notice, a KRW 2,450,000 increase over the 2025 floor. This route models only E-7-1 (the professional/general-office tier); E-7-2, E-7-3, and E-7-4 (the points-based skilled-worker track that most E-9 workers use to transition to longer-term status) carry materially different, generally lower salary floors and separate qualifying logic -- not modeled as separate groups here given the scope of this initial build, but flagged as the clearest candidate for expanding this route into a full multi-group file in a follow-up session, mirroring how the UK Skilled Worker route absorbed six qualifying groups. citizenship_after_months (60) and pr_after_months (60) use the general naturalisation/permanent-residence timeline; see kr_f5_permanent_residence and kr_naturalisation for the underlying route-level detail, including materially faster alternate tracks (e.g. the F-2-7 points-based route's 3-year path to F-5) that this route's holders commonly use instead of the plain 5-year track.
